pages.title: About Savanna & Beyond
pages.subtitle: Owner-operated, Kenya-based, and deeply committed to the places and people that make East African travel extraordinary.

sections.heading: Born on the plains of the Masai Mara.
sections.content:
Savanna & Beyond was founded in 2009 by James Kariuki, a KPSGA-certified guide who spent a decade working for international safari companies before realising that the people who understood Kenya best were rarely the ones designing the itineraries.

We started with two vehicles and a simple premise: build safaris the way a knowledgeable friend would — with genuine expertise, complete transparency, and an uncompromising commitment to the client experience.

Fifteen years later, we operate across Kenya and five other African countries. Our team of 40 includes some of the most experienced field guides in East Africa, a dedicated DMC division, and an operations team that runs 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.

pages.title: Sustainability
pages.subtitle: Responsible travel is not an add-on — it's how we operate. Our commitment to the wild places and people of Kenya is written into every decision we make.

items.title: Wildlife Conservation
items.content: We contribute 2% of every booking to the Mara–Serengeti conservation fund and support anti-poaching units in the reserves we operate in.

items.title: Community Investment
items.content: Over 85% of our staff come from Maasai and Kikuyu communities adjacent to the parks. We run a scholarship fund supporting 34 students annually.

items.title: Low-Impact Travel
items.content: Maximum vehicle numbers per sighting, off-road driving only in conservancies with lower visitor density, and strict adherence to park codes of conduct.

items.title: Carbon Commitment
items.content: We offset all ground transport emissions through the Lewa Wildlife Conservancy reforestation programme and are working toward net-zero by 2028.

items.title: Camp Standards
items.content: We only partner with lodges and camps that meet our sustainability checklist — solar power, waste management, grey water systems, and local procurement.

items.title: Responsible Photography
items.content: Our guides are trained in responsible wildlife photography ethics — no baiting, no crowding, no disturbing natural behaviour for a shot.

sections.heading: Africa is worth protecting.
sections.content: The wilderness that makes our safaris extraordinary is only here because it has been protected. Every safari we operate is a vote for conservation.

pages.title: DMC & Corporate Travel

pages.hero_image_alt: Corporate event in Kenya bush setting

items.title: VIP Arrival & Departure
items.content: Meet-and-greet at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport, fast-track immigration assistance, private transfers, and porter service — first and last impressions handled flawlessly.

items.title: Group Logistics
items.content: End-to-end logistics management for groups of 10 to 500 — rooming lists, meal management, transport coordination, and real-time communication protocols.

items.title: Ground Handling
items.content: Full-service ground handling across Kenya and East Africa — vetted vehicle fleets, licensed guide teams, and 24/7 operations desk.

items.title: Crisis Management
items.content: Dedicated crisis protocols, medical evacuation partnerships, and 24-hour response teams. Your delegates are never on their own.

items.title: MICE Travel
items.content: Conferences, incentive travel, exhibitions, and corporate events across Kenya's finest venues — from Nairobi hotels to tented conference facilities in the bush.

items.title: Corporate Retreats
items.content: Safari-based leadership retreats and team-building programmes in the Masai Mara, Amboseli, or the Rift Valley — where nature amplifies perspective.

items.title: Bespoke Events
items.content: Private dinners under the stars, sundowner experiences on the escarpment, bush weddings, and product launches — designed around your brand.
